# Dr. Nezah Balal

> Dr. Nezah Balal is a Senior Lecturer in Electrical and Electronics Engineering at
> Ariel University, Israel, Head of the Applied Magnetic Systems (AMS) Laboratory,
> and Adjunct Senior Teaching Fellow in Physics at the Technion. His research covers
> millimeter-wave (94 GHz, W-band) and micro-Doppler radar, contactless human
> sensing (speech-related vibration, fall detection, limb motion), radar target
> classification with machine learning, antenna design, applied magnetics and
> permanent-magnet undulators, and compact high-gradient particle accelerators.
> Hebrew name: נצח בלל. Note: "Y. Balal" (Yael Balal) is a different researcher.

Dr. Balal holds a PhD in Electrical Engineering (terahertz generation in
free-electron devices) and is an IEEE Senior Member. Contact: nezahb@ariel.ac.il.

## Research pages

- [Home](https://nezahb-max.github.io/): overview of research areas and technical
  capabilities in computational electromagnetics and numerical simulation.
- [Millimeter-wave & micro-Doppler radar](https://nezahb-max.github.io/radar.html):
  94 GHz radar systems for remote sensing, contactless human sensing and target
  classification, with MATLAB signal processing and machine learning; a simulated
  quadcopter micro-Doppler signature and a COMSOL model of a 77 GHz radar behind a
  bumper panel.
- [Antenna design](https://nezahb-max.github.io/antennas.html): horn, ultra-wideband
  (UWB) and millimeter-wave antennas and waveguide mode converters, full-wave COMSOL
  and CST modeling with experimental validation: a 3D-printed horn with a PTFE
  focusing lens, an antipodal Vivaldi (simulation) and a printed X-band mode converter.
- [Applied magnetism & undulators](https://nezahb-max.github.io/magnetics.html):
  permanent-magnet (NdFeB) helical and Halbach undulators and magnet systems,
  magnetostatic field maps, harmonics, tolerance studies and gaussmeter field mapping.
- [Compact accelerators & IFEL](https://nezahb-max.github.io/accelerators.html):
  inverse free-electron-laser acceleration with tapered helical undulators, modeled
  in COMSOL, MeV-scale energy gain over centimeters at high acceleration gradient.
- [Magnetic-mirror traps & particle dynamics](https://nezahb-max.github.io/particle-dynamics.html):
  electron confinement between two magnetic lenses with a live interactive simulation.
- [Electromagnetic simulations](https://nezahb-max.github.io/simulations.html): gallery
  of COMSOL models with field animations, from antennas and radar to indoor Wi-Fi.
- [Wi-Fi in an apartment with a safe room](https://nezahb-max.github.io/wifi-safe-room.html):
  2D COMSOL model of 2.44 GHz Wi-Fi propagation through the reinforced-concrete walls,
  door and shutter of a residential safe room (mamad).
- [AMS Lab overview](https://nezahb-max.github.io/ams-lab.html): the Applied Magnetic
  Systems Laboratory at Ariel University, research lines, outputs and funding.
- [Hebrew version](https://nezahb-max.github.io/he/): עמודי האתר בעברית, כולל
  https://nezahb-max.github.io/he/radar.html, https://nezahb-max.github.io/he/antennas.html,
  https://nezahb-max.github.io/he/magnetics.html,
  https://nezahb-max.github.io/he/accelerators.html (מאיצי חלקיקים קומפקטיים ו־IFEL),
  https://nezahb-max.github.io/he/particle-dynamics.html (מלכודות מראה מגנטיות ודינמיקת חלקיקים),
  https://nezahb-max.github.io/he/simulations.html (סימולציות אלקטרומגנטיות),
  https://nezahb-max.github.io/he/wifi-mamad.html (Wi-Fi בדירה עם ממ"ד).

## Selected publications (with DOI)

- Steinmetz N, Balal N. Feasibility Study of Real-Time Speech Detection and
  Characterization Using Millimeter-Wave Micro-Doppler Radar. Remote Sensing 17, 91
  (2025). https://doi.org/10.3390/rs17010091
- Balal Y, Steinmetz N, Sherenzon A, Balal N. Bending-Aware Spectrogram Correlation for
  W-Band Quadcopter Detection: A Physics-Informed Non-Coherent Detection Framework.
  Sensors 26, 4851 (2026). https://doi.org/10.3390/s26154851
- Steinmetz N, Magori E, Balal Y, Sudai YB, Balal N. A 94 GHz Millimeter-Wave Radar
  System for Remote Vehicle Height Measurement to Prevent Bridge Collisions.
  Sensors 26, 1921 (2026). https://doi.org/10.3390/s26061921
- Richter Y, Balal N. High-Resolution Millimeter-Wave Radar for Real-Time Detection
  and Characterization of High-Speed Objects with Rapid Acceleration Capabilities. Electronics 13, 1961 (2024).
  https://doi.org/10.3390/electronics13101961
- Richter Y, Balal N, Pinhasi Y. Neural-Network-Based Target Classification and
  Range Detection by CW MMW Radar. Remote Sensing 15, 4553 (2023).
  https://doi.org/10.3390/rs15184553
- Balal Y, Yarimi A, Balal N. Non-Imaging Fall Detection Based on Spectral
  Signatures Obtained Using a Micro-Doppler Millimeter-Wave Radar. Applied
  Sciences 12, 8178 (2022). https://doi.org/10.3390/app12168178
- Balal Y, Balal N, Richter Y, Pinhasi Y. Time-Frequency Spectral Signature of Limb
  Movements and Height Estimation Using Micro-Doppler Millimeter-Wave Radar.
  Sensors 20, 4660 (2020). https://doi.org/10.3390/s20174660
